name: Terraform
tagline: Infrastructure as code with plans, providers, CLI, and state.
shortDescription: Terraform gives agents a plan/apply workflow, provider ecosystem, CLI, state, and stable machine-readable IaC patterns.
agentSummary: Very agent-friendly because changes can be proposed in code and reviewed through plan output before apply.
bestFor: Infrastructure provisioning, reviewable cloud changes, drift inspection, and repeatable environments.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Never let agents apply production plans without human review, locked state, and scoped credentials. Deploys, secret changes, IAM, billing, networking, deletes, and rollback paths have high production blast radius; require scoped credentials and review gates. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging.
pricingSummary: Open-source CLI plus HCP Terraform paid team/governance plans.
authModel: Provider credentials, cloud tokens, HCP tokens, workspace permissions.
accountCreation: CLI is local; HCP Terraform is self-serve.
browserSupport: HCP Terraform UI supports plans, state, runs, and policy review.

capabilities.detail: CLI supports init, plan, validate, apply, import, state, and providers.
HCP Terraform API supports runs, workspaces, state versions, policies, and variables.
